name: Qwen3-TTS (CustomVoice, Base, VoiceDesign, Tokenizer)
usage: Speech synthesis: ready-made voices, cloning, voice design, codec

languages.value: 10 languages: zh, en, ja, ko, de, fr, ru, pt, es, it; all three variants
languages.note: CustomVoice has 9 preset voices covering combinations of gender, age, language and dialect: check how many sound natural in French and German. Cross-language cloning carries the accent over: use a reference recording in each language.

runtimes.value: mlx-audio (CustomVoice, VoiceDesign, Base cloning; mlx-community conversions); official qwen-tts package on MPS with device_map='mps' and bfloat16 (users on M3 Ultra and M4 Pro, CPU stalls, issue #69); vLLM-Omni through vllm-metal on PyTorch-MPS (documented for Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice, quantized models not supported). Base cloning degenerates when ref_text does not cover the whole reference clip (mlx-audio#921, reproduced with the official PyTorch code too)
runtimes.note: vllm-metal documents only the 0.6B CustomVoice; the 1.7B CustomVoice and Base there are unverified. flash-attn, recommended in the README, is CUDA-only.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of Ollama, QwenLM, resemble-ai/chatterbox and mlx-audio (now `Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio`). **Reddit could not be read.** Items from before 13.05.2026 that are not launch discussions are marked "older". Released 21.01.2026; window: since 13.05.2026 plus the launch. No feedback on the Tokenizer itself. Variants: CustomVoice has 9 preset voices and instruction or emotion control; Base clones voices but takes no instructions ([HF CustomVoice #28, 20.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice/discussions/28)).
web.summary: Excellent cloning on MLX; slow; accent carries over across languages; clone in each language from a reference in that language.
web.verdict: Qwen3-TTS: good; slow; preset voices with tone control

comments.text: Cross-language cloning keeps the original accent; the speaker sometimes changes ([QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS#134, 29.01.2026](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS/issues/134); [#80, 14.02.2026](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS/issues/80)).
Slow, not practical for real time ([rhdunn, 23.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49820470)).
mlx-audio: Base cloning produces garbage when `ref_text` does not match the whole reference clip ([mlx-audio#921, 28.08.2026](https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-audio/issues/921)).
One team switched to Chatterbox, found more predictable and reliable ([HF CustomVoice #28, 20.02.2026](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice/discussions/28)).

Used almost daily for voice cloning with mlx-audio ([rahimnathwani, 21.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48986493)); another user is fully convinced by its voice cloning ([jsemrau, 07.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48825291)).
**German**: worked well in a German test ([MacNCheese23, 23.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49821085)). Nothing on French.
